text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey's Senior Year
is finally about to begin—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
choice_data_list: (I-I feel like I'm suffocating...!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer.
Please, there's no need to be so tense."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "At a time like this, simply savoring the flavor of tea is all that matters."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: So... take it easy.
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah—
Y-yeah—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And so, with Orfevre joining in, how did we end up having a tea party right at the start of the new year again?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Hoping to ease my own nervousness, I decided to look back on how things unfolded—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Would you like to have a tea party?
choice_data_list: A tea party? With Journey?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...My parents often receive black tea and coffee beans
from their business clients."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: When I lived at home, my family would often gather during New Year's and holidays to enjoy the gifts we received together.
choice_data_list: Oh...! It's great how close you two are.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu, don't you think so?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "...Even after entering the academy, my family kept sending me those kinds of gifts, but..."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been able to host tea parties like I used to at home...
To put it simply, I'm at a bit of a loss with what to do with myself.
choice_data_list: I see, is that why you invited me?
I see, is that why you invited me?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If you'd like, I would be delighted
if you joined in on the fun with us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Back then, I casually agreed thinking I could be of help to Dream Journey, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...To think I'd be having a tea party with my younger sister, Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Between rarely having had a chance to speak with her and feeling overwhelmed by her aura, I can't help but want to straighten my back—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
That Darjeeling first flush was really wonderful, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
What about you, Or?
Did you find anything you like?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...This is Hallow's blend.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It really seemed like it'd go well with milk tea. Alright, I'll ask my mom to send some more.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer,
did you find anything that caught your eye?
choice_data_list: Ah, umm, I'm—
Ah, umm, I'm—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You've changed, Sister.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think?
That is why the tea tastes so delicious, too.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hey, you.
choice_data_list: Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I shall ask you now.
Answer truthfully.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—The thing you value most
as a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What is that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...There's no mistake.
I instinctively knew that right now,
Orfevre was putting me to the test."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why the serious answer that came to mind was—"
choice_data_list: The physical and mental health of myself and the Umamusume I train.
Proven ability as a Trainer
Absolute faith in my trainee

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey intends to keep running in the Twinkle Series
for a long time, just like "Big Sis."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To achieve that goal, I take constant care
to maintain both her mind and body,
as well as my own, since I must support her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Time and health are the limited capital of a 'journey.'"
On a journey, the body is the most essential thing
of all to keep moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It had become a steadfast policy
between myself and Dream Journey—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Because of the "journey," is it?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Then, even if my sister desires a "journey,"
what will you do if her body becomes incapable of it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Imagining that situation, a tearing sensation
shot through my chest for a moment.
Even so—
choice_data_list: If that's what Journey wants, I'll look for a way to make a comeback

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as her Trainer, before she ever
falls into such a situation—
choice_data_list: I'll protect Journey, no matter what

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Easier said than done.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: If that be so――

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
With every fiber of your being,
make your words truth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey is an exceptionally thoughtful
and capable Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To stand by her side as her Trainer, I need unquestionable ability—enough that no one, not even she herself, could complain...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I have confidence in everything I've done so far.
And going forward, I intend to aim even higher
as your Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because only then will we truly be able to
discover that "streak of gold" together—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...It is well that you know the weight of power.
However—"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
What if my sister were to find and choose
someone far more capable than you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Imagining that situation, a tearing sensation
shot through my chest for a moment.
Even so—
choice_data_list: If that's what Journey wants, I'll accept it

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As a Trainer, I should respect the path an Umamusume chooses to make her dream come true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...However.
As someone who has traveled on this "journey"
alongside Dream Journey thus far—
choice_data_list: —I won't let you find someone like that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To always remain the best Trainer for Dream Journey.
I have already made that resolve.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Easier said than done.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: If that be so――

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
With every fiber of your being,
make your words truth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A Trainer places absolute faith in their Umamusume's
ability, devotion to their dream, and hidden potential—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Believing wholeheartedly that they can win, achieve their dreams,
and grow without limits—that is why I can pour
every ounce of myself into my work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It is precisely through trusting them more than anyone in the world that they, too, can entrust their dreams to their Trainer.
...That is what a trainer contract is supposed to be."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed, I may have once harbored fear
toward the unfathomable depths
within Dream Journey."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —However, it's different now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I understand that this unfathomable nature of hers is precisely where Dream Journey's strength as an Umamusume lies. That is why—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Now, I can say with certainty:
I have immense trust in Dream Journey."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...A naive, honest soul, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
However, you have no way of knowing
whether my sister truly trusts you or not.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, what Dream Journey thinks of me
is her own sacred domain. However, that is precisely why—"
choice_data_list: Journey's trust isn't important

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The reason why I, as her Trainer, am important to Dream Journey is—
choice_data_list: It's about whether I'm actually useful or not.
It's about whether I'm useful or not.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Trust is something you must offer first.
Her response will come after all the accumulated results
and trust, and that is more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if there are none—
If it helps make Dream Journey's dream come true,
then that is what being a Trainer is all about.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
“...That gleam in your eyes.
It's nothing short of fanatical.”

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Still, the coloring isn't bad.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
If that be so, swear upon the light in those eyes
and make good on thy words.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...I'm going home.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Thank you for today, Or.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Did my sudden question catch you off guard?
choice_data_list: No, that's not true at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I interpret it as Orfevre's own way of testing whether I was worthy of being her sister's Trainer.
choice_data_list: If anything, I was actually glad you asked.
If anything, I was happy that you asked.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Surely, if I were insignificant, Orfevre would never have questioned me directly like that.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Your words were so direct and unhesitating,
they were truly reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: It is precisely because it is you... that there is something I want to share with you.
choice_data_list: Something you want to talk about?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: As you know, I have immense respect and affection for my younger sister, both as family and as a fellow Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...It's precisely because I respect and adore them—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I believe I must show it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —With my own running, I will reach the realm Orfe never could.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It was an expression, an emotion,
that I had never seen from Dream Journey before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking care not to make a loud noise,
I swallow hard—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Please don't forget
what we just talked about."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Because it's only for you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
......Well then.
Since we're already here,
would you like to go for Hatsumode after this?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Here's to our 'journey' being
a wonderful one this year as well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ……   Older sister   and   younger sister   .

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Whatever it is that exists between them, I realize I still don't comprehend it in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I'll press forward without hesitation.
Facing my Senior year alongside Dream Journey.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As fellow travelers on the same "journey"—
